title: SQLSIM — analytical similarity queries in PostgreSQL
conference: XVIII Brazilian e-Science Workshop (BreSci 2024), co-located with SBBD
scope: Execute the original PL/pgSQL functions and both original 2D/3D CUBE queries on all 569 original Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer observations supplied by the authors. Each query gets an isolated PostgreSQL/PostGIS instance, so parallel activities do not mutate one another’s clustering state. Transport path is adapted and PostgreSQL random seed is fixed to 0.42 for the authors’ generated hospital/date dimensions. Hospital locations and dates are illustrative generated dimensions, not clinical provenance. Runtime uses PostgreSQL 15/PostGIS 3 on Debian Bookworm rather than the paper’s PostgreSQL 16.3; result semantics, not timing equivalence, are checked. Original dataset: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/17/breast+cancer+wisconsin+diagnostic . Upstream repository has no explicit code license; no redistribution grant is inferred.
executionClaim: Adapted scientific workflow; completion and agreement are reported only by measured evidence.
